issues.title: The public-comparator experiment remains unexecuted
issues.requirement: After explicit human authorization, execute and independently audit the exact frozen 5000-call BIRD protocol and integrate the results; otherwise withdraw BIRD as a submission-readiness gate and justify the internal-only evidence boundary.

issues.title: Applied external validity remains development evidence
issues.requirement: Complete two independent qualified reviews and adjudication for all 91 external pairs and evaluate a sealed follow-up set with exact denominators, agreement, execution, and failure reporting.

issues.title: The release is not yet a portable public reproducibility package
issues.requirement: Complete licenses, DOI and declarations; use package-root-relative paths; and pass a recorded clean-directory regeneration and verification of hashes, denominators, contrasts, tables, and figure lineage.

issues.title: Prefer exact enumeration for the 12-cluster sign-flip test
issues.requirement: Enumerate all 4096 sign assignments, or disclose repeated Monte Carlo assignments and simulation uncertainty and use justified rounding.

issues.title: Disclose eligible-subset cluster-size imbalance
issues.requirement: Report the size profile or equivalent concentration summary and relate it to the composition-sensitivity interpretation.

issues.title: Formally define the factorial estimands for r
issues.requirement: Explicitly extend the three effects and cross-backbone modifiers to m=r on 66 questions and identify its distinct Holm-9 family.

issues.title: Expose statistical RNG lineage
issues.requirement: Report base seed 20260805 and the sign-flip/bootstrap family-offset rule, or bind it in a public machine-readable manifest verified from a clean directory.

reviewer_conclusion: The v5 multi-state integration is internally consistent and conservatively bounded, but the manuscript remains not submission-ready because public comparison, qualified external validation, and portable licensed release are open major gates.
